author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump said he was surprised to hear First Lady Melania speak out about Jeffrey Epstein. Inside Edition spoke with Melania's former Chief of Staff Stephanie Grisham. Melania says her relationship with Ghislaine Maxwell was "casual" and talked about an email she wrote to Maxwell that appears in the Epstein files. Melania also expressed support for Epstein's victims, calling for them to testify before congress, but they responded with criticism.
title: Was President Trump Blindsided By Melania's Press Conference?

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect is in custody after allegedly starting a fire at an Ontario, California, warehouse. The Ontario Fire Department responded to the call at the 1.2 million-square-foot facility operated by Kimberly-Clark, a distribution warehouse for paper products. Twenty-nine-year-old Chamel Abdulkarim has been identified as a suspect in the fire. In a video allegedly showing the arson, a man thought to be Abdulkarim says, "All you had to do is pay us enough to live." Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Employee Allegedly Burns Down Warehouse: "Pay Us Enough To Live"

description:
Sponsored Content by RoC Skincare.

Inside Edition teamed up with RoC® Skincare and its partner, dermatologist Dr. Sheila Farhang, for anti-aging tips. She says one solution is Micro-coring, but it involves needles and can be expensive. Dr. Farhang says she recommends RoC's Retinol Correxion Rich Cream as an affordable and non-invasive solution to help you look up to 10 years younger.
title: Dermatologist Says This Product May Help You Look Younger

author: Inside Edition
description: Governor Josh Shapiro was in Hershey, Pennsylvania, to announce the Commonwealth Concert series – part of the state's celebration of America's 250th anniversary. He was joined by some of the Keystone State's biggest names – Betsy Ross and Benjamin Franklin. Or at least, pretty good reenactors of the founding figures. All of a sudden, the America250PA backdrop toppled to the ground, nearly hitting the group on stage. Betsy Ross assured the concerned crowd that everything was ok.
title: Falling Backdrop Almost Flattens Pennsylvania Luminaries

author: Inside Edition
description: The First Lady delivered a surprise address regarding the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Melania Trump denied having a friendship with Epstein or his companion Ghislane Maxwell. She denied the rumors that she was introduced to her now husband, President Donald Trump, by Epstein. However, she does acknowledge his crimes and says she wants all those involved with his wrongdoings to be held accountable. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Melania Trump Calls On Congress To Have Public Epstein Hearing
